title: The forgotten list of recording artists
summary: Callender forgot to bring his list of the couple of hundred artists he recorded with.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now

blocks.x: Did you bring along that list of all the recording artists you've worked with?
Oh, my goodness! No, I didn't.
Well, we'll get to it on a subsequent reel. Because there were some people on there that I was going to ask you about.
Oh, yeah. At least a couple of hundred people.
